sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: The core gameplay in Home Run Master revolves around hitting home runs. The objective is to click at the right moment to swing your bat, aiming to hit the ball as far as possible. The game features a simple yet challenging mechanic that requires timing and precision. With each level, the speed and distance of the ball increase, making it harder to hit. As you progress, you'll encounter different types of balls, including curveballs, fastballs, and changeups, each requiring a unique approach. The game also features a power meter, which fills up as you hit the ball, allowing you to unleash a powerful swing and hit the ball out of the park.
